description: A solar superstorm like the Carrington Event could disrupt satellites, GPS, and power grids worldwide. Scientists warn that while rare, such events pose a serious threat to modern infrastructure, though improved monitoring and safeguards may reduce the risks.
title: Carrington-Level Solar Storm Could Disrupt Satellites, GPS, and Power Grids, Scientists Warn

description: Motorola Edge 70 Pro has been listed on the Geekbench benchmarking platform, a tipster claims. The listing reportedly reveals key details about the smartphone, including its chipset, OS version, RAM, and performance. The handset is said to be powered by an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 8500 chipset, which is said to feature a prime core, three performance, and four efficiency cores. The handset might ship with 12GB of RAM and Android 16. The company recently started teasing the launch of a new phone, hinting that the Motorola Edge 70 Pro could be launched soon in India. It is expected to go on sale in India via Flipkart.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Pro Lands on Geekbench Ahead of India Launch With 12GB of RAM, Dimensity Chip

description: The Stranger in My Home is an intense thriller film that explores the story of a couple’s life getting shattered after a stranger claims to be the biological father of their 15-year-old daughter.
title: The Stranger in My Home Out on OTT: Know Where to Watch This Thriller Film Online

description: Oppo Find X9s will be launched in select global markets on the same day as the Oppo Find X9 Ultra. However, the smartphone maker is seemingly not bringing the Oppo Find X9s Pro model to global markets, reserving it for the Chinese market. Along with the announcement, the company has also revealed the design and camera configuration of the upcoming smartphone. The handset will be equipped with a triple rear camera unit, housed inside a square-shaped camera island. On the other hand, the Oppo Find X9s Pro is teased to feature four cameras on the back.
title: Oppo Find X9s to Launch Globally Alongside Find X9 Ultra; Company Teases Design, Features

description: Here are some of the popular laser printers suitable for all users in India. All these models are priced under Rs. 50,000. Our picks include HP Laserjet Pro M501dn, HP Laserjet Pro M501dn, Canon ImageClass MF613CDW, HP Color LaserJet Pro Printer 3203dw, and Brother DCP-L5510DN. Buyers can compare their print quality, print speed, connectivity options and compatible paper sizes before making a purchase.
title: Best Laser Printers Available in India Under Rs. 50,000

description: Apple is said to be facing production delays with its first foldable iPhone. The purported handset, ubiquitously known as the iPhone Fold, previously targeted a 2026 launch timeline. A new report suggests that it has slipped behind schedule during its development phase. Consequently, this delay may impact production timelines and availability at launch, which is speculated to take place in September, alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max.
title: iPhone Fold Reportedly Faces Production Delay, Limited Availability Expected at Launch

description: A quirky comedy-thriller where carefree lives turn dangerous after an unexpected encounter with a killer.
title: Candy And The Pizza Ggirl OTT Release: When and Where to Watch, Plot, Cast, Trailer and Review

description: The American Bankers Association has criticised a White House report on stablecoin yields, arguing it overlooks key risks to bank deposits. The debate highlights concerns around financial stability as the stablecoin market grows. Policymakers are being urged to evaluate the long-term implications of yield-bearing digital assets on traditional banking.
title: White House Report Challenged by American Bankers Association on Stablecoin Yields

description: Oppo Pad 5 Pro and Oppo Pad Mini will launch on April 21. Oppo on Weibo posted new teasers revealing key specifications and colour options of the tablets. The Oppo Pad 5 Pro is teased to run on a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset. It has a 13,380mAh battery with 67W fast charging support. The Oppo Pad Mini will have an 8.8-inch OLED display and a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 SoC under the hood
title: Oppo Pad 5 Pro, Pad Mini Key Specifications, Colours, RAM and Storage Options Revealed

description: Redmi has begun revealing more details about its upcoming handset in China, the Redmi K90 Max. With its launch set for April 21, the Xiaomi sub-brand has shared information about the phone’s processor, along with its gaming capabilities. It is confirmed to be powered by a flagship Dimensity processor from MediaTek. The Redmi K90 Max will also feature a dedicated chip for handling graphics-intensive tasks, enabling 165fps support in gaming.
title: Redmi K90 Max Chipset, Gaming Features and Battery Details Confirmed Ahead of April 21 Launch

description: Xiaomi has listed the Redmi R70 5G and Redmi R70m 5G in China, revealing their specifications and pricing. Both phones feature a 6.9-inch 120Hz LCD panel, Unisoc T8300 chipset, and dual SIM 5G support. They offer similar cameras, with a 13-megapixel rear and 8-megapixel front sensor. The key difference lies in battery and memory, with the R70m offering a larger 6,300mAh battery and higher RAM. Both support 15W charging, run HyperOS 3, and come in multiple colour options.
title: Redmi R70 5G, Redmi R70m 5G Launched With Unisoc T8300 SoC, Up to 6,300mAh Battery: Price, Features

description: Oppo F33 Pro was reportedly spotted on the Google Play Console website, with model number CPH2835. The screenshot in the listing shows that the handset will feature 8GB RAM and a MediaTek MT6835 chipset, which refers to the MediaTek Dimensity 6100+ processor. The Oppo F33 Pro will launch in India on April 15 at 12pm IST. It will go on sale via Amazon and the Oppo India website.
title: Oppo F33 Pro Reportedly Lands on Google Play Console Shortly Before Its Launch in India

description: Resort is a Tamil comedy-drama web series that is now available to stream only on JioHotstar. The series explores the workplace politics and ambitions behind a beach resort.
title: Resort Streaming Now on JioHotstar: All You Need to Know About This Tamil Web Series

description: Metro 2039 will be officially revealed at an Xbox First Look event this week, developer 4A Games has announced. The first-person shooter will get a global reveal on April 16. Metro 2039 is the fourth mainline Metro game and a follow-up to 2019's Metro Exodus.
title: Metro 2039 Will Be Officially Revealed at Xbox First Look Event This Week

description: OnePlus Pad series is set to grow by one soon, as the Chinese smartphone maker has started the launch of a new tablet in India. Along with the teaser, the company has published an image, which shows the silhouette of the upcoming device. It is shown to feature a pill-shaped rear camera module. The OnePlus branding appears in the middle of the rear panel, too. Reports suggest that the teaser could either belong to the OnePlus 3 Pro or the OnePlus Pad 4, which might take over as the company’s next flagship tablet. It is expected to feature a 13.2-inch 3.4K LCD touchscreen, offering up to 144Hz of refresh rate.
title: OnePlus Pad Lineup Set to Expand as Company Teases Launch of New Model

description: Oppo A6s Pro has been launched in China as the latest addition to the company’s A6 lineup. The smartphone is scheduled to go on sale in the country on April 17. However, currently it is available for pre-order via the Oppo China online store. The phone is offered in three colour options, dubbed Good Fortune Abounds (white), Moon Shines Brightly in the Night (blue), and Soaring to Great Heights (silver) (translated from Chinese). The phone is backed by a 7,000mAh battery with support for 80W SuperVOOC wired fast charging.
title: Oppo A6s Pro Launched With 7,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Former CFTC Chair Chris Giancarlo is stepping away from his legal role to focus on advising cryptocurrency firms and contributing to policy discussions. His move comes amid growing regulatory focus on crypto in the US, highlighting the increasing overlap between traditional finance leadership and the digital asset industry.
title: Former US CFTC Chair Chris Giancarlo Departs Willkie, Plans to Advise Cryptocurrency Firms

description: Asus Zenbook S14, Zenbook Duo, Zenbook A14 and the Zenbook A16 have been launched in India alongside the new Vivobook lineup. The latest Vivobook family includes the Vivobook 14, Vivobook 16, Vivobook S14 and Vivobook S16 models. The Vivobook 14 and 16 are compatible with up to an Intel Core Ultra 5 325 processor, while the Vivobook S14 and Vivobook S16 feature up to an Intel Core Ultra 7 355 processor.
title: Asus Zenbook, Vivobook Range Launched in India With Intel Core Ultra and Snapdragon X2 CPUs: Price, Specifications

description: Samsung is expected to launch the Galaxy M47 soon, as the device has appeared on internal test servers in India and Nepal with model number SM-M476B, according to a new report. The phone was earlier spotted on the IMEI database, confirming development. It may arrive in the second half of the year with 5G support and bring upgrades over the Galaxy M44. Expected features include competitive pricing, a Super AMOLED display, and a large battery. The Galaxy F70 Pro is likely to be its counterpart.
title: Samsung Galaxy M47 Reportedly Listed on Software Testing Servers, Could Launch Soon

description: Vivo is said to be broadening its ambitions in mobile imaging beyond the conventional smartphone camera. Following the launch of the Vivo X300 Ultra at the company’s recent spring launch event, senior executives shared deeper insights into the philosophy and technology behind its latest flagship. An expansive roadmap was also outlined, which builds upon the Vivo X300 Ultra’s imaging capabilities but also looks at new device form factors and accessories that could address real-world needs.
title: Vivo Reportedly Eyes Vlogging Camera, Broader Imaging Ecosystem Following Vivo X300 Ultra Launch

description: Apple last month announced a new unified platform, aimed at helping companies manage devices, streamline operations, and expand their reach across its ecosystem. Called Apple Business, it is available starting today in more than 200 countries. As the Cupertino-based tech giant describes, the platform consolidates several existing enterprise tools, such as Apple Business Essentials and Apple Business Manager, into a single interface.
title: Apple Business Now Available in Over 200 Countries: What You Need to Know

description: Lenovo Legion Y70 (2026), the tech firm’s next-generation gaming phone, will be launched in China in May, the company announced on Monday. While not much is known about the smartphone, it is expected to compete with the Red Magic 11 Pro series. The gaming handset was also recently spotted in a leaked hands-on image, which suggested that it might feature a triple rear camera unit and an LED flash, housed inside a square-shaped rear camera module. Lenovo’s last Legion Y series gaming phone was launched in China in August 2022, creating a near four-year gap between the debut of the two models.
title: Lenovo Legion Y70 (2026) Set to Make a Comeback in May After Nearly Four Years

description: New Microsoft Gaming CEO believes Xbox Game Pass has become "too expensive". In a leaked internal memo, Sharma, who replaced Phil Spencer as Xbox chief in February, said that Game Pass was now "too expensive for players" and Microsoft needed to find “a better value equation."
title: New Xbox Chief Asha Sharma Says Game Pass Has Become 'Too Expensive for Players'

description: Realme Narzo 100 Lite 5G has been launched in India as the latest edition to the smartphone maker’s Narzo lineup. The new handset is set to go on sale in the country via Amazon. The phone is offered in two colour options, dubbed Frost Silver and Thunder Black. It is powered by an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset. The new smartphone also boasts a 7,000mAh battery, which is claimed to provide up to 10 hours of video playback on a single charge. Moreover, it gets a dual rear camera system, headlined by a 13-megapixel AI camera.
title: Realme Narzo 100 Lite 5G Launched in India With 7,000mAh Battery, 144Hz Display: Price, Specifications

description: Bitcoin climbed toward $74,000 as improving global sentiment and strong inflows into crypto investment products triggered a relief rally. Ethereum and other altcoins also posted gains, though analysts caution that the move remains driven by macro factors and lacks confirmation of a sustained breakout.
title: Bitcoin Price Climbs Above $74,000 as Relief Rally Boosts Crypto Market Sentiment

description: The Xiaomi 17 series was launched in China in September last year, and now leaks about the Xiaomi 18 series have started popping up online. A new leak suggests that the Xiaomi 18 Pro will come with battery and camera upgrades over the Xiaomi 17 Pro. It is said to run on a new chipset manufactured using the 2nm process. It could offer 100W wired charging support and wireless charging support. The Xiaomi 18 Pro is likely to be revealed in the second half of this year.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Leak Hints at Specification Upgrades Including Dual 200-Megapixel Cameras and Bigger Battery

description: Motorola is expected to launch the Razr 70 Ultra soon alongside the Razr 70, with the device possibly branded as the Razr Ultra 2026 in the US. It may retain many features of the Razr 60 Ultra, including the Snapdragon 8 Elite chipset and dual displays. The phone is tipped to feature a 7-inch inner screen, a 4-inch cover display, and three 50-megapixel cameras. It could pack a larger 5,000mAh battery, support 68W charging, run Android 16, and offer similar design, dimensions, and IP48 rating.
title: Motorola Razr 70 Ultra Key Specifications Leaked; 5,000mAh Battery, Snapdragon 8 Elite SoC Expected

description: Apple will reportedly use the optically clear adhesive (OCA) to achieve a crease-free touchscreen on its first foldable handset, according to a report. This specially optimised glue usually comes in handy for bonding glass. In the smartphone industry, OCA is often used for creating a bond between the protective films and the display glass, since it is not visible to the naked eye. However, Apple will reportedly leverage the adhesive’s viscoelastic properties, which determine how much deformation any material can undergo before breaking.
title: Apple Ultra Will Reportedly Use Special Adhesive to Offer Crease-Free Foldable Display

description: Motorola Edge 70 Pro could launch in India and global markets soon. Ahead of the formal launch, the Edge series smartphone has appeared on the TDRA website with the model number XT2607-1.  The upcoming handset is rumoured to ship with a Snapdragon 8 series chipset and a 50-megapixel selfie shooter. It could feature a 6,500mAh battery with 90W fast charging support. The Motorola Edge 70 Pro is expected to come with upgrades over last year's Motorola Edge 60 Pro
title: Motorola Edge 70 Pro Spotted on TDRA Certification Website; Global Launch Seems Imminent

description: Apple is expected to launch the iPhone 18 Pro models in September. The lineup may introduce a deep red colour option, with tipsters and reports suggesting prototypes and renders of the shade. Other expected colours include grey and silver. Apple is also testing two display designs: one with the current layout and another with a smaller “Mini Dynamic Island” that uses under-display Face ID components. The final decision is pending, while the rear design is likely to remain largely unchanged.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Leak Hints at Deep Red Colourway Again, Months Ahead of Anticipated Debut

description: A massive leak originating from the Indonesian ratings board has revealed major story spoilers and footage from several unreleased games, including IO Interactive's 007 First Light. The game's ending has reportedly leaked with over an hour of footage circulating online. The leak occurred due to a security flaw with the Indonesian Game Rating System (IGRS).
title: 007 First Light Suffers Major Leak; Story Spoilers, Game Ending and Gameplay Footage Surface Online

description: The Redmi K90 Max is set to go official in China soon. It is expected to join the existing K90 and K90 Pro Max models in the Xiaomi sub-brand’s lineup. Soon after the company confirmed its launch date, the upcoming handset has now surfaced on a benchmarking site, with the listing revealing several key specifications. The Redmi K90 Max is said to ship with 16GB of RAM. It may run on Android 16.
title: Redmi K90 Max With Dimensity 9500 Chip, 16GB of RAM Surfaces on Geekbench Ahead of China Launch

description: The Vivo X300 Ultra and Vivo X300 FE are set to be unveiled in the global markets soon, joining the X300 and X300 Pro as the latest additions to the flagship lineup. Ahead of its anticipated debut, the launch date of the upcoming handsets in India has been leaked by a tipster. Both models are tipped to be introduced in early May. Sales of the X300 Ultra and X300 FE may begin on May 14.
title: Vivo X300 Ultra, Vivo X300 FE India Launch Date Tipped; May Go on Sale Starting May 14

description: Oppo F33 and Oppo F33 Pro will launch in India on April 15 with dual rear cameras and 7,000mAh batteries. Both devices will be available for purchase through Amazon and the Oppo India website. With the launch just days away, here's a quick roundup about the launch details, expected price, specifications, and features of the duo.
title: Oppo F33, Oppo F33 Pro India Launch on April 15: Everything You Need to Know

description: OnePlus Nord Buds 4 Pro were recently launched in India as the latest entrant in the sub-Rs. 4,000 price in the true wireless stereo (TWS) segment. As a “Pro” device in the Nord family of products, the new earbuds have to shoulder a lot of responsibility without asking buyers to break the bank. The new Nord Buds 4 Pro comfortably outperforms its competition in most aspects. The new earbuds offer a balanced sound, with bass never overshadowing the highs. Moreover, the Nord Buds 4 Pro shines in battery life. However, there are a few cons that might have been overlooked.
title: OnePlus Nord Buds 4 Pro Review: Budget Buds, Flagship Silence
